source.citation: Sedra & Smith (2014). Section 17.4 LC notch filter, extended here as a loaded nonideal capacitor-selection task.

selected_cap_nF.description: Capacitor from {75, 91, 110, 130} nF that gives the deepest 5033 Hz notch with the loaded nonideal trap
selected_cap_nF.T_good_source: LTspice stepped Ctrap list shows the 110 nF candidate gives the deepest 5033 Hz notch once 10 kOhm load and 0.35 ohm inductor DCR are included; no candidate is exactly at the ideal resonance.

dc_gain.description: |V(out)| at 100 Hz for selected_cap_nF, including 10 kOhm load
dc_gain.T_good_source: Oracle stepped LTspice 26.0.1 run at selected C=110 nF measured -0.845 dB at 100 Hz with the 10 kOhm load included.

notch_depth.description: |V(out)| at 5033 Hz for selected_cap_nF, including 10 kOhm load and inductor DCR
notch_depth.T_good_source: Series LC trap at resonance is no longer ideal because no candidate lands exactly on 5033 Hz and because load plus 0.35 ohm inductor DCR limit the notch; oracle stepped LTspice 26.0.1 measured -30.839 dB for C=110 nF.
